name: hgi_sm_xq_pegress

pin_regs.reason: every input lands in a pin register in RTL (rw, e6, e5r replicas, bc_*, bq_c, bqvr) and every output is a register (owner rule 19:50)

floorplan_note: XQL pair-egress leaf x3 (H-SM 10-16, SM_X option (b) confirmed by H-DIE 18:43: 4 pair stores/quadrant in one band-gap column at the pair boundary, enclosed-row egress at the column E corner, xw windows >= 360 um, cut <= 0.55, <= 6 pins/um per face (target 5.73), 100 um pair channel, die ~855.3 mm2): 369.36 x 369.36; every face spread evenly by spread_face_pins.py (margin 4.32): N 2,063 xw pins over 360.72 um = 5.72/um (alternating M3/M5), W 2,048 bq_d over 360.72 = 5.68/um (M4), S 1,024 rwq = 2.84/um, E 42 controls, clk centred on E. Pin-limited leaf (3,923 um2 std, 5,135 pins): util stays low by construction. x2 345.6 x 302.4 had N 6.1/um and W 7.0/um (> owner 6 pins/um rule); x1 auto pin bands 9.8/um -> GRT-0116.
slot_change_request: XQL pair-store column leaf, SM_X option (b) (H-DIE 18:43): 369.36 x 369.36 (x2 345.6 x 302.4, x1 302.4 x 302.4)

job.purpose: XQL pair-egress leaf: the ctl egress (rw capture, replicated beat select, BD beat capture, xw pins) per SM pair, beside the pair store
job.structural_change: x3 supersedes x2 (hgi_sm_xq_pegress-x2-153565d5e): SM_X option (b) geometry + owner <= 6 pins/um per face: 369.36 x 369.36, N xw 5.72/um over a 360.72 um span (H-DIE window >= 360 um, target 5.73/um), W bq_d 5.68/um, S rwq 2.84/um, even spread (spread_face_pins.py). x1 hgi_sm_xq_pegress-x1-ee1d52825 GRT-0116 cause: auto pin regions packed 2,063 xw pins into a 210 um band (9.8/um) + 2 outhold pads/pin -> 29 top-row gcells M3 V cap+1. RTL, benches, pin faces unchanged.
